entities.summary: Else Berg was a German-born Dutch painter of Jewish descent; associated with the Bergense School. She was married to the Dutch painter, Mommie Schwarz. She and her husband were both murdered in the Holocaust. Else Berg was a architects & designers from Racibórz (1877-02-19, Racibórz–1942-11-19). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
